issue.title: TestDeathSaysExitAndLastWords red under load on Linux: 'read |0: file already closed' wins over the exit status
issue.body:
`TestDeathSaysExitAndLastWords` (internal/pii) went red in a full `go test -tags nogui -timeout 45m ./...` on the Linux box (wsl-run, magpie-desktop), at 2260390a0. Another session's full suite and GUI suite were on the same box at the same time.

```
--- FAIL: TestDeathSaysExitAndLastWords (0.19s)
    serve_test.go:223: err = the local masking model failed: read |0: file already closed, want the exit status and the assert
FAIL
FAIL	github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/pii	24.073s
```

(The `pii: the local model panicked … panicFinder.Find` stack just before it in the log comes from astrlink_test's panicFinder, which is expected and recovered.)

Alone, `-run TestDeathSaysExitAndLastWords -count=20 ./internal/pii` on the same box passes 20 of 20.

What it looks like: when the fake `asserts` pf-serve dies, the reader of its pipe sees `read |0: file already closed` before the exit status and last stderr lines are picked up. So the error a user gets is the pipe error, not "exit status 3" with the GGML_ASSERT. That suggests `cmd.Wait` (which closes the pipes) runs before the read is done, or the error from the read is taken over the one from the process's death. A user on a busy machine would see the same unhelpful message. It is not linked to 2260390a0, which doesn't touch internal/pii.

Not investigated further. Not taken by me.

comments.body:
A fix is on [the fork branch](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/5334-closed-pipe-ending), commit [8bbdb812e](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/8bbdb812e9c243f9c831f3ae843e729aa717c561), based on ed0ab567.

When another path ends pf-serve (a stop, an idle end or a hung-serve kill) while the request reads its answer, the read end closes under the reader and `os.ErrClosed` reaches the user as `read |0: file already closed` instead of the process's ending. `fail` now treats `os.ErrClosed` exactly as it treats EOF, so `died()` supplies the exit status and last stderr.

`TestClosedPipeSaysTheEnding` waits for the fake pf-serve to exit, closes the read end, and wants `exit status 3` with `GGML_ASSERT(ne00 % 4 == 0) failed`. Before the change it reports `read |0: file already closed`; afterwards it passes. The mutated code was restored byte for byte. Focused race tests, pii vet, the full offline nogui build, formatting and diff checks pass. The full suite and macOS/Windows runs were not made; this pipe behavior is platform-independent. AI-assisted implementation and review.
